entries.applicability: Java 17 to 25; callers relying on the default List contract.
entries.compat: Keeping get(0) also avoids introducing a method absent from the Java 17 List interface.

evidence.supports: An index outside the list bounds throws IndexOutOfBoundsException, including index zero on an empty list.

evidence.locator: List.getFirst(), Implementation Requirements, Throws and Since
evidence.supports: The default implementation throws NoSuchElementException when empty; the method was added in Java 21.

entries.migration: Retain get(0) when preserving its empty-list exception is required; inspect caller handling before adopting getFirst().
entries.summary: JDK 25 List.getFirst() and JDK 17 List.get(0) differ for empty lists.
entries.verification: Official API documentation checked; custom List implementations and project runtime behavior remain unverified.
